checkpoint_policy: Fresh start from the same parent for every arm. Fixed final epoch 80. Intermediate TRAIN probes are diagnostic only and cannot select a checkpoint.

development_plan: Only after both seeds pass training feasibility, compare final checkpoints, matched controls and unchanged parent on all three frozen development panels. Retain threshold 0.8, IoU 0.5, split_merged and aspect 2.42913421076193. Do not promote on training fit or one favorable seed.
